L: Length of the plank or strut
d: Distance of the sign from the wall
f: Fraction of the ladder's length the person has climbed
h: Height of the cable's wall end above the hinge
m: Mass of the painter or sign
theta: Angle of the cable to the strut, or of the ladder to the floor
theta_min: Smallest angle before the ladder slips
x: Position of the load from the left end
